scope: Actual local indexed lifecycles and wakeup workers for 2/10/100 synthetic landlords, 20/100/300 workflows each; phases retain earlier history. Every tenth workflow loses first idempotent-provider acknowledgment.

measurement.agent: Injected immediate wakeup acceptance, scripted engine calls; no real Grok or inference. Readiness evidence is an explicit trusted benchmark fixture.
measurement.cpu: Whole-process lifecycle deltas and idle sweeps; per-tenant sequential attribution includes shared scans, not private tenant CPU
measurement.network: Outbound business JSON bytes; provider body proxy is estimated, HTTP/TLS/vendor traffic excluded
measurement.memory: Sampled process RSS, not billed container memory
measurement.rateLimits: Bulk sampler lifts starts/sec to avoid clock-compression throttling; production/default budgets are tested in acceptance suite
